name: Mega Pulse Cannon
doc: Mega Pulse Cannon (Trauma's enemy attack): the master and its tasks - electric arcs over the caster's body to a muzzle point on its skeleton (as Mega Spark's), charge sparks flying into it, the cannon and beam layouts there, falling sparks at the tips of its bones, rocks thrown up round it, the screen flash, spot layouts at the targets, the sound, a stream load; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag287_mega_pulse_cannon.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer); it has no file (its TIMs are exe data).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The main task's timeline: the sound, the screen flash's level, the stream load, the damage (every target of action 0), the end

parts.title: Cannon
parts.doc: The cannon layout at the muzzle point (an offset on a bone of the caster, held still after a while), turned with the caster, its texture scrolling

parts.title: Beam
parts.doc: The beam layout at the muzzle point at the caster's height, its texture scrolling the other way

parts.title: Arcs
parts.doc: Electric arcs (screen-space ribbons, jittered) over the caster's body from triangles of its skeleton to the muzzle point, an arc a tick; each fades out after a while, the last ones dropped

parts.title: Charge sparks
parts.doc: Sparks round the muzzle point on the first ticks, flying back into it

parts.title: Falling sparks
parts.doc: Sparks at the tips of a run of the caster's bones, falling

parts.title: Rocks
parts.doc: Rocks thrown up round the caster, bouncing on the ground

parts.title: Spots
parts.doc: A layout at each of up to three targets in turn
